rows.currentScript: Read line 31 to the end of line 32. The dog snuffs round, then runs to her. Find the words no other help at hand. That is the reason, tucked into a dash.
rows.whyRewrite: Script bounds the reading to 'line 31 to the end of line 32' then says 'Find the words no other help at hand', but 'help at hand to summon' is on line 33, outside the range it sets; 'tucked into a dash' is also an unexplained device a child cannot act on.

rows.currentScript: Read line 26 and line 27 as one speech. She says how horrid, then gives an order. The order is about removing a mark from a floor. That is a housekeeping answer.
rows.whyRewrite: Supports only the first half of the key (wants the mark gone, lines 26-27); never shows the half that separates it from the distractors, that she asks nothing about whose blood it is. 'That is a housekeeping answer' is a label the child must decode, not evidence, and 'how horrid' is left unaddressed against the 'frightened' option.

rows.currentScript: Read line 33 and find the words cared less, which weigh two wants. One is Tom enjoying more puff; the other is Tom being pleased with her. Line 34 says which of the two won.
rows.whyRewrite: Never connects the weighing of two wants to the act the question asks about ('So she shut her eyes quite close', line 35), and 'Line 34 says which of the two won' misplaces the deciding words, which are 'cared less' on line 33; the 'pure sacrifice' option ('did not extend so far', line 33) is left unaddressed.

rows.currentScript: Line 49 has Ben offer the core of his apple. Line 51 has Tom say no again and start to back away. Line 52 has Ben offer all of it, so each refusal raises the price.
rows.whyRewrite: 'Line 51 has Tom say no again and start to back away' claims something the passage does not say; line 51 is "Well, here—No, Ben, now don't. I'm afeard—", with no backing away (he half-offers, then refuses).
